approvedLocalContent.coverageLimitations: Basic defects warranty with separate component periods and wear exclusions; the 100,000 km gate is the conservative intersection of documented use regimes, not a universal manufacturer cap.

estimationConvention: Displayed year is fabrication year plus the validated coverage term. It is an estimate; the manufacturer term starts at original sale/delivery under the applicable manual. Resale does not restart or grant a new full period.
presentationRequirements: Keep the basic-vehicle and traction-battery scopes visibly distinct.
Use the traction-battery label for the eight-year coverage; never present it as general or 12 V battery coverage.
Keep official model/year source references and the visible estimate/conditions note.
Do not extend either record to another vehicle ID, model, model year or use category.
